items.title: 欧洲科学与艺术院长 Klaus Mainzer：通用人工智能的终极通关秘籍，藏在思想史里 GAIR Live | 018
items.raw_excerpt: 当一位德国顶尖科学家把《易经》称作“二进制祖先”，并断言下一代 AI 必须靠“人文学者的想象力”突围，这或许意味着：真正的通用人工智能，或许要先在思想史里通关。 作为一位享誉国际的科学哲学家和复杂系统理论权威，欧洲科学与艺术院院长、慕尼黑工业大学荣休教授 Klaus Mainzer 不仅是连接数学逻辑与现代科技的桥梁，更是洞察人工智能时代人类命运与责任的战略思想家。 在最近雷峰网对 Mainzer 院长的深度专访中，他不仅全面回顾了 AI 理论从图灵到量子计算的发展脉络，更犀利地指出了 AGI 无法绕开的哲学困境、工程创新的全球转移，以及培养未来人才最迫切需要的教育系统变革。 从莱布尼茨（Leibniz）在 17 世纪对《易经》阴阳符号的扩展研究，到 1936 年图灵那篇奠定数字时代的《论可计算数》，再到今天试图用“模拟计算”破解停机问题的接口项目——Mainzer 用一条清晰的“思想链”告诉我们：AI 的每一次跃迁，背后都站着哲学家、语言学家、逻辑学家、现象学家甚至外交官；人文与科学并非“两种文化”，而是一条麻花辫，越拧越紧。 访谈伊始，Mainzer 院长就直指现代 AI 的理论限制。他承认 AI 在数据驱动的模拟方面能力惊人，但其根基仍受制于形式化思维。他援引逻辑学史上哥德尔（Gödel）的“不完备性”最终被根岑（Gentzen）以“超限数”概念所克服的案例，强调 AI 的逻辑困境并非不可逾越。 然而，一旦进入 AGI 的核心地带，Mainzer 院长提出了一个尖锐的哲学挑战：机器能模拟情感，但能拥有“灵感”吗？ “机器可以模拟各种情感表达，我对此毫不怀疑。但区别在于创造力。一个作曲家需要的是情感和灵感。” 他指出，AGI 面临的真正障碍是“具身性”（Embodiment）的哲学鸿沟。Mainzer 院长推测，未来或许能通过神经生物学创造出具备“活体组织”和“情感”的

excerpt_i18n.en: When a leading German scientist calls the I Ching the "ancestor of binary" and asserts that the next breakthrough in AI must rely on the imagination of humanities scholars, it may suggest that achieving true artificial general intelligence requires first mastering intellectual history. Klaus Mainzer, an internationally renowned philosopher of science and authority in complex systems theory, president of the European Academy of Sciences and Arts, and emeritus professor at the Technical University of Munich, not only bridges mathematical logic with modern technology but also serves as a strategic thinker who keenly observes humanity's destiny and responsibilities in the AI era. In a recent in-depth interview with Leifeng.com, Mainzer comprehensively traced the evolution of AI theory from Turing to quantum computing, sharply highlighting the philosophical dilemmas AGI cannot bypass, the global shift in engineering innovation, and the urgent need for educational system reforms to cultivate future talent. From Leibniz's 17th-century expansion of the I Ching's yin-yang symbols to Turing's 1936 paper "On Computable Numbers" that laid the foundation for the digital age, and today's interface projects using analog computing to tackle the halting problem—Mainzer illustrates with a clear "chain of thought" that every leap in AI has been supported by philosophers, linguists, logicians, phenomenologists, and even diplomats. He emphasizes that the humanities and sciences are not "two cultures" but a tightly woven braid, growing ever closer. At the start of the interview, Mainzer directly pointed out the theoretical limitations of modern AI.
excerpt_i18n.es: Cuando un destacado científico alemán calificó el I Ching como el "antepasado del sistema binario" y afirmó que la próxima generación de IA debe avanzar gracias a la "imaginación de los humanistas", esto podría significar que la verdadera inteligencia artificial general quizás deba superar primero la historia del pensamiento. Como reconocido filósofo de la ciencia y autoridad en teoría de sistemas complejos, Klaus Mainzer, presidente de la Academia Europea de Ciencias y Artes y profesor emérito de la Universidad Técnica de Múnich, no solo es un puente entre la lógica matemática y la tecnología moderna, sino también un pensador estratégico que analiza el destino y la responsabilidad humana en la era de la IA. En una reciente entrevista en profundidad con Mainzer por parte de Leifeng.com, revisó exhaustivamente la IA.

items.title: Arm加速端侧AI普及的「妙招」，把Lumex CPU的AI性能提升5倍

excerpt_i18n.en: The wave of generative AI is shifting from the cloud to the edge, and edge AI is key to its widespread adoption. However, edge devices are generally more power-sensitive, so how can sufficient AI performance be provided while ensuring low power consumption? Arm's solution is embedding dedicated matrix acceleration units directly into the CPU. James McNiven, Vice President of Product Management for Arm's Client Business, stated that this allows edge AI inference to be performed directly on the CPU, significantly reducing data transfer delays between the CPU, NPU, or GPU. In September of this year, Arm launched the Arm Lumex CSS platform, integrating the new second-generation Arm Scalable Matrix Extension (SME2) technology, which boosts CPU AI performance by up to five times and optimizes energy efficiency by three times compared to the previous generation. At the recent Arm Unlocked 2025 AI Technology Summit in Shenzhen, James McNiven further detailed Arm's new Lumex CSS platform, which integrates a CPU cluster based on the Armv9.3 architecture, processors with the second-generation Scalable Matrix Extension (SME2) technology, Mali G1-Ultra GPU, advanced system IP, and a production-ready physical implementation optimized for the 3-nanometer process node. excerpt_i18n.es: La ola de la IA generativa está pasando de la nube a los dispositivos, y la IA en el dispositivo es clave para su popularización. Sin embargo, estos dispositivos suelen ser más sensibles al consumo energético. ¿Cómo garantizar un rendimiento suficiente de IA con bajo consumo? La solución de Arm es integrar unidades de aceleración matricial dedicadas directamente en la CPU. James McNiven, vicepresidente de gestión de productos de la división de terminales de Arm, afirma: "Esto permite que la inferencia de IA en el dispositivo se realice directamente en la CPU, reduciendo significativamente la latencia en la transferencia de datos entre la CPU, la NPU o la GPU". En septiembre de este año, Arm lanzó la nueva tecnología de segunda generación de matriz escalable (SME2) integrada.

items.title: AI 的本质不是算力，而是「上下文革命」
items.raw_excerpt: 过去几年，人工智能的浪潮一次又一次刷新人们的想象：模型变得更大、算力更强、应用更广。 但在光鲜的成果背后，一个更深层的问题被不断暴露 —— AI 真的“理解”世界了吗？它能记住对话，却常常忘记语境，能生成答案，却未必明白问题的由来。人们开始意识到，智能的边界，不在算法，而在语境。 正是在这样的背景下，上交大生成式人工智能实验室（GAIR Lab）提出了一个颠覆性的观点：人工智能的本质不是算力革命，而是“上下文革命”。 他们在最新论文中，把“上下文”从语言模型的附属概念，提升为智能系统的核心结构，认为系统理解世界的方式，取决于它如何吸收、组织并重构语境。 这项研究通过回溯上下文系统的演化历史，结合大量系统实验与理论建模，提出了“上下文工程”（Context Engineering）这一全新学科框架。团队发现，从早期依赖传感器和规则的 Context 1.0，到能够跨模态理解语义的智能体 2.0，AI 的每一次跃迁，都是一次对“语境吸收力”的升级。 在参数增长趋于极限的当下，这项研究像是在为人工智能指明新的出路：当机器不再只是记住语境，而能理解并创造语境，也许，那才是真正的智能时代的开始。 语境，才是智能的真正边界 这篇论文的实验结果揭示了一个重要规律：人工智能的进步，归根结底取决于系统对“上下文”的理解和利用能力，也就是它能多好地吸收、组织和重构语境。 作者通过比较不同代的智能系统，总结出了上下文工程的发展路径。他指出，从最早依赖传感器和规则运行的系统（比如 Context Toolkit、Cooltown），到如今能理解自然语言和多模态信息的智能体（如 ChatGPT、LangChain、Letta），智能的提升，其实就是系统能处理的语境越来越复杂。 早期的系统只能根据明确输入作出反应，而现在的系统已经能通过语义推理理解人类意图，做出更自然的互动，这标志着上下文工程正式进入

excerpt_i18n.en: In recent years, the wave of artificial intelligence has repeatedly reshaped people's imaginations: models have grown larger, computing power stronger, and applications broader. Yet behind the impressive achievements, a deeper issue has consistently emerged—does AI truly "understand" the world? It can recall conversations but often forgets context; it can generate answers but may not grasp the origins of questions. People are beginning to realize that the boundary of intelligence lies not in algorithms but in context. It is against this backdrop that Shanghai Jiao Tong University's Generative AI Lab (GAIR Lab) has proposed a groundbreaking view: the essence of AI is not a computing revolution but a "context revolution." In their latest paper, they elevate "context" from a peripheral concept in language models to the core structure of intelligent systems, arguing that how a system understands the world depends on how it absorbs, organizes, and reconstructs context. By tracing the evolution of context systems and integrating extensive experiments with theoretical modeling, the research introduces a new disciplinary framework called "Context Engineering." The team found that from the early Context 1.0, reliant on sensors and rules, to the more advanced Agent 2.0 capable of cross-modal semantic understanding, each leap in AI represents an upgrade in "context absorption capability." As parameter growth approaches its limits, this research points toward a new path for AI: when machines no longer just remember context but can understand and create it, perhaps that marks the true dawn of the intelligent era.
excerpt_i18n.es: En los últimos años, la ola de inteligencia artificial ha renovado una y otra vez la imaginación de las personas: los modelos se han vuelto más grandes, la potencia de cálculo más fuerte y las aplicaciones más amplias. Pero detrás de los brillantes logros, un problema más profundo se ha expuesto continuamente: ¿realmente la IA "comprende" el mundo? Puede recordar conversaciones, pero a menudo olvida el contexto; puede generar respuestas, pero no necesariamente entiende el origen de las preguntas. La gente comienza a darse cuenta de que el límite de la inteligencia no está en el algoritmo, sino en el contexto. Es en este contexto que el Laboratorio de Inteligencia Artificial Generativa de la Universidad Jiao Tong de Shanghái (GAIR Lab) propuso una perspectiva disruptiva: la esencia de la inteligencia artificial no es una revolución de la potencia de cálculo, sino una "revolución del contexto". excerpt_i18n.en: When it comes to the core term for competition in 2025, autonomous driving may be the most representative. As the new energy industry has evolved, with the three-electric systems gradually maturing and becoming homogeneous, electrification itself has shifted from a disruptive innovation to a basic threshold, making autonomous driving the new competitive focus, and the cycle of historical breakthroughs is set to repeat. In the 2000s, the internet era saw Windows and Intel build the foundational architecture of the digital world. In the 2010s, the mobile internet era, Apple reshaped how people connect with information. In the 2020s, OpenAI pushed digital cognition to new frontiers. Today, with AI continuously advancing, its expansion beyond the digital world has become a consensus among leading tech companies. While Apple increases its investment in generative AI, it has also been revealed to be developing a desktop robot with autonomous navigation capabilities, exploring AI's interactive abilities in physical spaces. Amazon's Astro home robot and DeepMind's ongoing investments in robot control models under Google indicate that tech giants view "physical AI" as a key gateway to the next generation of human-computer interaction. Xiaopeng was one of the earliest domestic automakers to delve into AI; back when in-vehicle computing power was only 30 TOPS, He Xiaopeng was already convinced that autonomous driving would be the core path for humanity to reach the AI endgame. This early start in autonomous driving positioned Xiaopeng as a frontrunner among domestic automakers in this field from its inception, with some plans like automation.
excerpt_i18n.es: Al hablar de la palabra clave de la competencia en 2025, la conducción autónoma podría ser la más representativa. Hasta ahora, en el desarrollo de la industria de energías renovables, con la maduración y homogeneización gradual de los sistemas de tres componentes eléctricos, la electrificación en sí ha evolucionado de una innovación disruptiva a un requisito básico, y la conducción autónoma se ha convertido en el nuevo punto de competencia, reapareciendo el ciclo de avances históricos. En la era de Internet de los años 2000, Windows e Intel construyeron la infraestructura subyacente del mundo digital. En la era de la Internet móvil de los años 2010, Apple reinventó la forma en que las personas se conectan con la información. En los años 2020, OpenAI llevó la cognición digital a nuevos límites. Hoy en día, tras la continua evolución de la IA, su expansión más allá del mundo digital ya es una realidad para las principales empresas tecnológicas.
